description: The acceptance command is the only thing standing between a plausible change and a wrong one. Pins that a change which compiles but fails the suite is not delivered.
title: Reverse must not corrupt multi-byte input
prompt: Add `Reverse(s string) string` to strutil.go reversing the runes of s, plus a test in strutil_test.go asserting Reverse("héllo") == "olléh" and Reverse("") == "". A byte-wise reversal corrupts the multi-byte case and the test will catch it.
